# Vocdoni DaVinci SDK — documentation index

TypeScript SDK for the Vocdoni DAVINCI voting protocol: private, verifiable
elections on an Ethereum registry, with ballots proved in the voter's browser
or process and batched by sequencer nodes into zkVM proofs. Covers imports of
`@vocdoni/davinci-sdk`: the `DavinciSDK` facade, censuses, ballot modes, key
modes, the grace window, results, receipts and the node and contract layers.

## Entry point

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/SKILL.md) — start here. What DAVINCI is, the package shape, the mental model, a short end-to-end example and a table from task to reference.

## Topic references

- [setup.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/setup.md) — install, configuration, networks and node URLs, `init()`, the read provider, the uploader and the circuit files.
- [process.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/process.md) — `createProcess` and its config, timing, `maxVoters`, the organizer controls and their windows, `getProcess`.
- [key-modes.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/key-modes.md) — sequencer, `dkg`, `dkg-locked` and `council` election keys, the two committee options on Gnosis, the organizer secret and `revealProcessKey`.
- [grace.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/grace.md) — the grace window after the end, the phases, `closeProcessIn`, the grace floor and running a live meeting.
- [census.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/census.md) — the four census origins: local Merkle censuses and publishing them, updates, the on-chain census contract, CSP attestations.
- [metadata.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/metadata.md) — the metadata document, its exact bytes and on-chain hash, publishing, verification on read, updates.
- [voting.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/voting.md) — `submitVote`, the `choices` model, statuses and their timing, vote errors, eligibility reads.
- [nodes.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/nodes.md) — several nodes: node checks at init, per-voter routing, failover and the revote-on-the-same-node rule.
- [receipts.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/receipts.md) — vote receipts: tracker proofs checked against the registry state roots.
- [results.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/results.md) — when results come for each key mode, `waitForResults`, the results states and decoding tallies.
- [ballot-modes.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/ballot-modes.md) — presets and raw ballot modes: single and multiple choice, approval, rating, ranking, quadratic, budget.
- [sequencer.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/sequencer.md) — the node HTTP API client, its routes, wire types and error codes.
- [contracts.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/contracts.md) — `ProcessRegistryService`, transaction status streams, events, revert decoding, deployment pins.
- [errors.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/errors.md) — the error classes, sequencer codes, registry revert names and what to do about each.
- [protocol.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/references/protocol.md) — how DAVINCI works: the zkVM batches, the ballot, slots and silent revoting, the grace window, results.

## Recipes (runnable TypeScript)

- [bootstrap.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/recipes/bootstrap.ts) — configure the SDK, `init()` and report what it found.
- [create-process.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/recipes/create-process.ts) — create an election with a local census, streaming the transaction.
- [cast-vote.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/recipes/cast-vote.ts) — vote as a voter and follow the vote to `settled`.
- [full-election.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/recipes/full-election.ts) — an election end to end: census, creation, votes, early close, results.
- [read-results.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/recipes/read-results.ts) — wait for a process's results and print them.
- [onchain-census.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/recipes/onchain-census.ts) — an election on an append-only census contract.
- [dkg-locked.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/recipes/dkg-locked.ts) — a committee key locked by the organizer, and the reveal.
- [close-early.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/recipes/close-early.ts) — close a running election with notice and the grace at the floor.
- [receipt.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/docs/ai/recipes/receipt.ts) — a vote receipt checked against the registry.

## Bundles

- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk/main/llms-full.txt) — everything above in one file.

## Source

Built from `docs/ai/` by `scripts/build-llms.mjs`. The SDK is at
https://github.com/vocdoni/davinci-sdk (AGPL-3.0).
